headline: Mallplaza Proposes $200 Million Commercial-Residential Development in Concón
summary: Mallplaza presented its Aires de Concón project details to local council members, detailing a $200 million plan featuring 412 apartments and 200 retail stores.
why: Mallplaza is a leading shopping center developer in South America, operating extensive commercial square footage in Chile, Peru, and Colombia.

impacts.name: Mallplaza
impacts.why: Mallplaza unveiled plans for a $200 million real estate development in Chile.
